inline.label: Inline
inline.hint: Sits in your page and grows to fit the form. Best for most pages.

lightbox.label: Popup
lightbox.hint: A button that opens the form over your page.

iframe.label: Basic iframe
iframe.hint: No script needed. Fixed height. For sites that strip scripts.

button.label: Button
button.hint: A link styled as a button. Opens the form in a new tab.

options.heightFixedNote: A basic iframe can't resize itself — pick a height that fits your longest page.
options.transparentHint: Let your page's own background show through around the form.
options.closeOnSubmitHint: Dismiss the popup a few seconds after the respondent submits.

preview.label: Preview
preview.noteAutoHeight: On your page the height follows the form's content as the respondent moves through it.
preview.noteFixedHeight: The frame stays at this height. Content taller than it will scroll inside the frame.
preview.noteLightbox: On your page this opens over your content when the button is clicked.

platformNote.wordpress: Paste into a Custom HTML block, not the visual editor.
platformNote.react: Renders the form once the component mounts. Safe to use more than once on a page.
platformNote.webflow: Use an Embed element — script tags are allowed there.

warnings.draft: This form is a draft. Visitors will see “form not found” until you publish it, but you can copy the code now.
warnings.gated: Forms that ask respondents to sign in can't be embedded yet — signing in doesn't work inside a frame. Share a link or a button instead.
warnings.fixedHeightMultiPage: This form has more than one page. With a fixed height, longer pages will scroll inside the frame — “Fit content” is usually better.

qr.help: Scanning this opens the form link.
qr.renderFailed: Couldn't generate a QR code for this link.
